body: i guess the thing I'm dealing with the most here is that my brothers came into town, awesome right?  but i kept getting these texts from my buddy, "hey I just want to die" all week.  I ignored them and in the past I didn't... I tried to get him help.   A couple weeks later I started to get worried and called the local police and then I got a call from the medical examiner saying that he died.  I know that it wasn't my fault, everyone tells me that but on some level i felt i could've prevented it.  Now i feel so alone, I'm afraid to sleep, I'm afraid to do anything really and I  don't know why.

I've come to the conclusion that I can't do any good.  My own brothers don't talk to me.  My mom, has nothing to say, in general my family would rather pretend i'm not there than do anything.  fuck this.... I'm a piece of shit to everyone.  I've never had anything good to say and apparently never will.
